mapper.insert: INSERT INTO move ( id, type_id, target_id, class_id, category_id, ailment_id, name, description, power, pp, accuracy, priority, effect_chance, ailment_chance, crit_rate, drain, flinch_chance, healing, max_hits, min_hits, max_turns, min_turns, stat_chance, generation ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{typeId}, #{targetId}, #{classId}, #{categoryId}, #{ailmentId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{power}, #{pp}, #{accuracy}, #{priority}, #{effectChance}, #{ailmentChance}, #{critRate}, #{drain}, #{flinchChance}, #{healing}, #{maxHits}, #{minHits}, #{maxTurns}, #{minTurns}, #{statChance}, #{generation} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pp = VALUES(pp), priority = VALUES(priority)
INSERT INTO move_stat_change ( move_id, stat, `change` ) VALUES ( #{moveId}, #{stat}, #{change} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.id ,m.name ,m.power ,m.accuracy ,m.pp ,m.description ,t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name ,t.color AS type_color ,ma.id AS ailment_id ,ma.name AS ailment_name, ma.description AS ailment_description ,mca.id AS category_id ,mca.name AS category_name ,mca.description AS category_description ,mc.id AS class_id ,mc.name AS class_name ,mc.description AS class_description ,mt.id AS target_id ,mt.name AS target_name ,mt.description AS target_description FROM move m JOIN type t ON m.type_id = t.id JOIN move_ailment ma ON m.ailment_id = ma.id JOIN move_category mca ON m.category_id = mca.id JOIN move_class mc ON m.class_id = mc.id JOIN move_target mt ON m.target_id = mt.id WHERE m.is_active = 'Y' AND t.is_active = 'Y' AND ma.is_active = 'Y' AND mca.is_active = 'Y' AND mc.is_active = 'Y' AND mt.is_active = 'Y'
